name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, US counties
aggregation_form: percentile rank of the sum of the four themes' sums of variable percentile ranks - not a weighted sum of the theme ranks
source: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, county file, https://svi.cdc.gov/Documents/Data/2022/csv/states_counties/SVI_2022_US_county.csv
note: The four theme columns are each theme's percentile rank among counties, as published. All four are computed from one survey, the American Community Survey, so unlike HDI's indicators they share an instrument.
